# `resultMatchToFromResult`

Suggests Effect.fromResult when Result.match or a Result guard conditional only converts Success to Effect.succeed and Failure to Effect.fail

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377165` |
| Language Service name | `resultMatchToFromResult` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/result-match-to-from-result` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect, Result } from "effect"

declare const parsePort: (raw: string) => Result.Result<number, Error>

export const port = Result.match(parsePort("8080"), {
/**
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(result-match-to-from-result): `Effect.fromResult` expresses this Result-to-Effect conversion more directly than `Result.match` or a Result guard conditional.
*/
  onFailure: (error) => Effect.fail(error),
  onSuccess: (value) => Effect.succeed(value)
})
```
